verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an LLM gateway and SDK, for example batch requests or bulk key and user management. The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk-operation capability. Related features such as load-balancing, proxy-wide budgets and fallbacks are adjacent controls that act on traffic or config. They are not user-invoked operations across many items at once, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
